body:
# 🧹 iClearLag - Optimized Performance & Lag Clearing
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6329ba5aee7d5b48c8999632cca291b603f3482.jpeg)
---
**iClearLag** is a premium-quality performance plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers (1.16 - 1.21+). It doesn't just clear items; it optimizes your server's TPS and FPS in real-time using advanced culling and AI management techniques.

---

> ## ✨ Key Features

- 🚀 **Smart Entity Clearing:** Fully customizable automated clearing of items, mobs, projectiles, and experience orbs.
- ⚡ **Real-time Optimizations:**
  - **Chunk Entity Culling:** Automatically prevents chunks from being overloaded with too many entities.
  - **Spawner AI Management:** Disable AI for mobs spawned from spawners to massively boost TPS on mob farms.
  - **Hopper Optimization:** Reduces the performance overhead of hopper inventory checks.
- 🎨 **Premium Aesthetics:**
  - **Pastel HEX Support:** Stunning modern color palette for all messages and interfaces.
  - **Dynamic BossBar:** A smooth, real-time countdown bar for upcoming clearings.
  - **Interactive Feedback:** Sound effects, particles, titles, and action bars for every event.
- 🌍 **Multi-Language Support:** Native support for **English** and **Spanish** with auto-switching based on your config.
- 📊 **Server Stats:** Real-time monitoring of TPS, entity counts, and memory usage.

---

> ## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/icl help` | Shows the help menu | None |
| `/icl time` | Shows time until next clearing | None |
| `/icl clear` | Forces a manual clearing | `iclearlag.admin` |
| `/icl reload` | Reloads the configuration | `iclearlag.admin` |
| `/icl stats` | View server performance stats | `iclearlag.admin` |

---

> ## ⚙️ Configuration

The plugin is designed to be plug-and-play but offers deep customization for power users.

### Language Auto-Switching
Simply set `language: "en"` or `language: "es"` in `config.yml`, run `/icl reload`, and the plugin will automatically update your `lang.yml` to the selected language!

---

> ## 🚀 Performance
> Built with Kotlin and highly optimized code, iClearLag ensures minimal impact on your main server tick while providing maximum stability.
